title: Ship a small feature, one verified step at a time

nodes.title: Write observable acceptance criteria
nodes.exit_check: One accepted example and one rejected example are documented.

nodes.title: Define data and state transitions
nodes.exit_check: Inputs, outputs and failure states are explicit.

nodes.title: Implement the smallest working path
nodes.exit_check: The accepted example runs through the core.

nodes.title: Connect the interface
nodes.exit_check: A user can complete the accepted flow.

nodes.title: Exercise failure and recovery paths
nodes.exit_check: Invalid input and interrupted work leave consistent state.

nodes.title: Review the integrated feature
